Video Encoding

The NetworkHD 120 series takes the award-winning 100 series and elevates to a new level. The 120 series components support both video encoding/decoding. With 4K resolution, video transmissions look better than ever and use up to 6x less bandwidth. AV stream are fully secure over the network using AES 128-bit encryption methods, ensuring any sensitive data cannot be maliciously accessed. Of course, the series would not be complete without retaining the powerful video wall and Multiview processing. The 120 series does one better by adding screen rotation and mosaic video wall ability.

The NetworkHD TM 100 Series utilizes low bandwidth, infinitely scalable technology with the addition of powerful video wall support up to 16×16 for the best all-round solution for commercial AV installations. A 100 Series encoder can either be paired with a 100 Series decoder for matrix switching to individual screens or for video wall decoding, with both decoders including HDMI and analog audio breakout outputs, or an NHD-150-RX decoder for multiview monitoring.
The NHD-120-TX can encode AV signal using low bandwidth compression technology. Using this technology provides incredibly efficient video streams.

The NHD-120-TX is now supporting 4K content that ensures compatibility with the HDMI v1.4 HDCP 2.2 video source, while a built-in scaler ensures hassle-free mixing of the latest 4K displays and 1080p screens within an installation.
The 120 series also allows you to create mosaic video walls with image rotation.

Boasting the ultimate in signal flexibility, the 120 Series can discretely deliver audio, infrared, and RS-232 streams separate to the video via a modular IP network. True signal breakaway can create custom assignments.
Compatible with the NetworkHD Touch and Companion Control apps. Control source, matrix and video wall switching with preview streams of each encoder.

recommendedWhen: Flexible, scalable or distributed source-to-display routing is required.

salesLanguage.headline: NHD-120-TX: moves AV around the building using the network
salesLanguage.plainEnglishSummary: Use this when sources and displays are spread out, the customer needs flexible routing, or the system may grow over time.
salesLanguage.customerValue: It turns AV into a more flexible system where content can be routed to different places without redesigning fixed cabling every time.
salesLanguage.realWorldApplication: Campuses, sports bars, casinos, command rooms, education buildings and large distributed AV systems.
salesLanguage.salespersonCue: Sell the flexibility and future-proofing, then validate the network design.
talkTrack: It is strongest when the system needs expansion, many endpoints, or routing across distance.
It depends on the network, so switch selection and commissioning matter.
It is not automatically the best option for every multi-display room.
